description: Lets users sign in on shared devices with a FIDO2 security key or NFC badge, without a password and without setting up Windows Hello for Business on the device. Baseline assignment: none by default — belongs on SEC-Shared-Devices. Source: Own baseline — OMA-URI ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PassportForWork/SecurityKey/UseSecurityKeyForSignin = 1, as in IntuneAdmin/IntuneBaselines (Baseline - Enables FIDO Security Keys to be used during Windows Sign In)..

omaSettings.displayName: Turn on FIDO Security Keys for Windows Sign-In
